definitions.ask: Where should the ⌘↵ Gmail hint chip appear?
definitions.why: The chip never lies and adds no standing noise; review landings surface it when it matters.

choices.label: Only on the cursor's row — quietest; walk landings reveal it since landing moves the cursor
On every qualifying row while marks are on — more discoverable, one standing chip per row

definitions.ask: Should Cmd+Enter act on any line carrying a mail wikilink, or only on task rows?
definitions.why: One predicate shared by chip and keymap is simpler to specify, test, and trust.

choices.label: Any line whose own text carries a resolving mail wikilink — one uniform predicate everywhere
Only task rows and their link-only mail children; log-bullet mail links do nothing

definitions.ask: Create the new glossary strand defining "Gmail Task" (sase/memory/glossary/gmail-task.md)?
definitions.requested: As a part of this change, we should add an excellent new "gmail task" glossary term.
